meta.title: Avistry: make a bought avatar yours in minutes
meta.description: Free Unity tool for VRChat avatars. Pick a part, recolour it, paint on layers and save a new PNG. Your original files never change.
hero.title: Make a bought avatar yours in minutes.
how.title: Four steps, one window.
how.1.title: Pick a part
how.1.body: Click it on the model or on the texture. The same pieces light up in both.
how.2.title: Choose a colour
how.2.body: Shift the colour. Shading and patterns stay where they were.
how.3.title: Paint a detail
how.3.body: Brushes and gradients, kept inside the pieces you picked.
how.4.title: Save a new copy
how.1.alt: A click on the black forearm sleeve on the model, then a Shift+click on the second glove piece in the texture: both pieces light up orange on the model and in the texture, and the panel reads 2 pieces selected.
how.2.alt: Black has no hue to shift, so the glove is tinted instead: as you pick a colour along the bar, from rose through violet to blue, the glove turns from black to navy, its shine and seams unchanged, on the model and in the texture.
how.3.alt: With the Spotlight on, a pink stroke is dragged along the forearm, over the sleeve and into the gold bangles. It lands only on the two picked pieces, the strap and bangles stay clean, and a Paint layer appears in the layer list.
how.4.alt: Clicking Save as new PNG adds Glove_ats.png, Glove_ats.mat and an edit recipe in the Sleeve folder, next to the unchanged Glove.png and Glove.mat.
how.req: Needs Unity 2022.3, the version VRChat uses.
look.label: Saved look
look.crimson.legend: Crimson: hair and wings to red, metal to gold, with a magenta and cyan chrome tattoo.
look.frost.legend: Frost: hair and wings to ice blue, metal to silver, with an ice-blue and cyan chrome tattoo.
look.venom.legend: Venom: hair and wings to green, metal to charcoal, with a green and teal chrome tattoo.
look.orig.alt: The same avatar before editing, without the tattoo: pink and black hair, pink eyes, purple crystal horns, black and pink wings, same pose and light.
look.crimson.alt: The avatar in the crimson look on a club stage, one hand on the hip: red and orange hair, red eyes, gold horns with glitter, spread gold and red wings and a magenta and cyan chrome tattoo on the face and body, under light beams on a dark violet backdrop.
look.frost.alt: The avatar in the frost look on a club stage, both hands on the hips: ice-blue hair and eyes, steel-blue outfit, ice-blue crystal horns, silver-blue wings and an ice-blue and cyan chrome tattoo on the face and body, under white light beams on a dark blue backdrop.
look.venom.alt: The avatar in the venom look on a club stage, one arm raised and the other hand on the hip: acid-green and black hair, green eyes, green crystal horns, black and green wings and a green and teal chrome tattoo on the face and body, under green light beams on a dark green backdrop.
how.panel.alt: The compact side panel tabs: Target, Colour, Select, Paint and Save.
